nivraBericht.description: NIVRA-bestand projection for a closed period: every posted GLTransaction + child GLLines + audit-trail events + period trial-balance + chart of accounts in effect. Output conforms to the NIVRA standard referenced in _meta.standardVersion. No PHP audit-export service: pure declarative aggregation + docudesk XML template.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod to export.

standardVersion.description: Controleprotocol version reference. Defaults to the current standard year.

lines.description: All debit/credit lines for each posted transaction.

chartOfAccounts.description: Chart of accounts in effect for this administration.

steekproef.description: Deterministic random sample of posted GLTransaction records for substantive testing. Given periodId, sampleSize, and seed, returns a reproducible ordered sample: re-running with the same seed yields the same records in the same order. Shillinq#425: the previously-declared `guard` (OCA\Shillinq\Guard\SteekproefSampler) referenced a class that did not exist, AND OpenRegister's aggregation engine never reads a `guard` key on any aggregation at all. It was dead, unconsumed configuration regardless of the class (same defect shape as the near-duplicate `engineLimitFallback` reference on this same aggregation key in lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json, which points at a different nonexistent class, OCA\Shillinq\Audit\SteekproefSampler. Filed as shillinq#436 for both).

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod to sample from.

sampleSize.description: Number of GLTransaction records to include in the sample.

seed.description: Reproducibility seed: same seed with same period produces the same sample. Convention: 'audit-YYYY-qN' or operator-supplied string.

lines.description: All debit/credit lines for sampled transactions.

meta.adimensionalNote: ADR-031 exception path: if the OR aggregation engine cannot guarantee deterministic seed-sampling across engine versions, OCA\Shillinq\Guard\SteekproefSampler::computeDeterministicSample provides a ~20-LOC fallback using PHP's seeded shuffle.

ledenraadpleging.description: Redacted slice of posted GLTransaction records for raadsleden review. Fields tagged redactFor: ['raadsleden'] are replaced by a stable SHA-256 hash (description-level free-text) or [REDACTED] placeholder (AP/AR sub-ledger refs). Numeric and account-code fields remain intact. No PHP redaction service: redaction profile is declared as aggregation metadata per ADR-031.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod to export.

lines.description: All debit/credit lines for each posted transaction.

description.description: Free-text posting description may carry personal data (e.g. 'Salaris Jan Bakker maart 2026'). Replaced by SHA-256(description).

GLLine.description.description: Free-text line description. Replaced by stable hash.

sourceReference.description: AP/AR sub-ledger reference numbers that may identify persons. Replaced by [REDACTED] placeholder.
